scenario: flash flood and landslide, Nepal, monsoon 2024
note: Every LIVE step is computed on the phone from data it already carries. The two cited steps are measurements made elsewhere in this project and stated as such.

steps.ne: २०२४ सेप्टेम्बर २८ — नेपालमा १६७ पहिरो गएको दिन। त्यस दिन ६१३ मध्ये ३१ ढलान वर्षाको सीमाभन्दा माथि थिए।
steps.en: 28 September 2024 - the day Nepal recorded 167 landslides. 31 of 613 slopes were at or above the rainfall threshold that day.

steps.ne: अगस्टमा उपग्रहको तस्बिरको १६.८% मात्र प्रयोगयोग्य थियो, र १४२ मध्ये १७ स्थान कहिल्यै देखिएन। त्यसैले प्रणाली 'सबै ठीक' भन्दैन — 'देख्न सकिन' भन्छ।
steps.en: In August only 16.8% of satellite scenes were usable, and 17 of 142 sites were never seen at all. So the system does not say 'all clear' - it says it cannot see.

steps.ne: यो जमिन कसको जिम्मामा — नजिकैको अभिलेखित ढलान, त्यसको नगरपालिका, जिल्ला र वेबसाइट।
steps.en: Whose ground is this - the nearest documented slope, its local unit, district and website.

steps.ne: कहाँ भाग्ने र कति माथि — उचाइको डेटाबाट, फोनमै। कहीँ माथि नभए 'दौडन नखोज्नुहोस्' भन्छ।
steps.en: Where to run and how high - from the elevation grid, on the phone. Where there is nowhere higher it says do not run.

steps.ne: उजुरीको मस्यौदा — त्यही कार्यालयलाई, धारा उल्लेख गरी। एपले पठाउँदैन; नागरिकले पठाउँछ।
steps.en: The complaint, drafted to that office with the section cited. The app does not send it; the citizen does.

steps.ne: जोड्नु नपर्ने सन्देश — २० बाइट, ब्लुटुथ विज्ञापनभित्र। न जोड्नु, न एप खोल्नु।
steps.en: A message that needs no connection - 20 bytes inside a Bluetooth advertisement. No pairing, no app open on the carrier.
